description: Ask MIND which folder a piece of content belongs in. Reads every folder's routing_hint (set via mind_folders set_hint) and uses a cheap LLM to pick the best match. Returns folder_id=null when no folder's hint clearly applies — in that case leave the doc unfiled rather than guess. Typical agent flow: suggest → mind_remember (create the doc) → mind_folders move_documents (file it to the suggested folder).

content.description: The text of the new document you're about to file. The picker reads it against every folder's routing_hint.

title.description: Optional title — helps the picker disambiguate short content.

name: mind_folder_suggest
